entities.summary: John Calvin Fleming Jr. is an American politician, physician, and former naval officer serving as Treasurer of Louisiana since 2024. A member of the Republican Party, he previously served as White House Deputy Chief of Staff under President Donald Trump and was the U.S. representative for Louisiana's 4th congressional district from 2009 to 2017.
